params.name: query-by-field
params.description: This field determines by which attribute session data to be queried. Session data can be queried by subscription-id or msisdn or iccid.

params.name: query-by-values
params.description: This field expects one or more values up to 100 for the field selected in the query-by-field.

params.name: include-active-sessions
params.description: Include details of the active/open session in the response. Default value is false.

params.name: date-range-start
params.description: Session count and session data can be queried for any duration within the last 7 days, and this field defines the start of duration. Value format should be ISO-8601 having milliseconds precision, e.g. 2020-05-30T22:38:23.085Z.

params.name: date-range-end
params.description: Session count and session data can be queried for any duration within the last 7 days, and this field defines the end of duration. Value format should be ISO-8601 having milliseconds precision, e.g. 2020-05-30T23:38:00.000Z.

params.name: page-number
params.description: Session data is paginated, and this field defines the page number to be queried.

params.name: page-size
params.description: Session data is paginated, and this field defines the page size to be queried.

params.name: sort-by
params.description: Session data can be sorted by startTime in ASC or DESC order. Value format should be field:order and default supported is startTime:DESC

params.description: Unique identifier for an account
